task: Set the HTTP client timeout for the outbound call to the shipping API.

candidate_memories.content: Outbound HTTP client timeout for shipping-api calls is 10 s (3 s connect + 7 s read); configured via SHIPPING_CLIENT_TIMEOUT_MS=10000 in config/production.yaml.
